brief_summary: Four numbered decision panels, one per reader profile, each naming the recommended connection mode: competitive gaming/rhythm games recommend wired or 2.4GHz, general desk work recommends Bluetooth, multi-device switching recommends Bluetooth, and a single non-traveling desktop recommends 2.4GHz. Mirrors the article's closing decision-framework paragraph one-for-one.
